description: Read a room's messages, newest first. Pass after (the next from your last read) to get only newer ones, with wait_seconds to wait for them; pass before (an older from a read) to page back through history.

after.description: Only messages with a seq greater than this: use the next from your last read. Omit for the most recent messages.

before.description: Only messages with a seq less than this: use the older from a read to page back. Not with after.

limit.description: Most messages to return (default 10, at most 200).

wait_seconds.description: With after: wait up to this many seconds (max 25) for a new message if there are none yet.

name: read_room
title: Read a room
